name: Multiphysics Modelling
description: Vector and tensor calculus, tensor identities, coordinate transformation; description of motion and deformation, deformation gradient tensor, strain tensor; deformation of area and volume, conservation of mass, material derivative, description of the rate of deformation and rotation; description of force, stress, and traction; conservation of linear and angular momentum; conservation of energy: first law of thermodynamics; second law of thermodynamics: Clausius-Duhem inequality; equation of state; constitutive modelling: linear and nonlinear elasticity, linear viscosity, generalized Newtonian fluids, viscoelastic materials; modelling electrohydrodynamic flows; interface modelling: diffuse and sharp interface methods for multi-material systems; discussion on Eulerian, Lagrangian, and arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian methods for modelling multi-material systems.
